# asc_security_group_attachment (Resource)

Manages a Security Group attachment to a target resource (e.g. VirtualMachine) in the ASC platform. This attaches a Security Group's network rules to a specific target.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `security_group_name` (String) The name of the Security Group to attach.
- `target_name` (String) The name of the target resource to attach the Security Group to.
- `target_type` (String) The type of target resource to attach to. Valid values: VirtualMachine, Pod.

### Read-Only

- `attachment_name` (String) The name of the attachment resource created in Kubernetes.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the security group attachment.
